scope: 35 local Rust zoned date/time and injected-clock dependencies. Implementation and requirement statuses unchanged.
source_comparison: Frozen Temporal proposal via durable checklist rows. ECMA-262 remains requested authority.

review_timing.scope: Patch and evidence assembly after initial source/proposal review.

key.symbol: impl<C: SystemClock> Now<C>::instant

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §2.3.1 steps 1–2 and §2.2.2 step 2: Read and clamp the injected clock.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Reads the injected clock once, clamps exact epoch nanoseconds to the Instant bounds and wraps them as an Instant. The injected clock owns the current UTC approximation.

key.symbol: impl<C: SystemClock> Now<C>::zoned_date_time_iso

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §2.2.4 steps 3–4: Read the instant and wrap it with the supplied zone and ISO calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Uses self.instant and the provided typed zone to create a ZonedDateTime whose default calendar is ISO. Zone selection is outside this entry point.

key.symbol: impl<C: SystemClock> Now<C>::plain_date_time_iso

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §2.2.3 steps 1–2: Project the injected clock into a local ISO date-time.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Reads the same source through zoned_date_time_iso, then delegates exact local projection using the supplied typed zone and ISO calendar.

key.symbol: impl<C: SystemClock> Now<C>::plain_date_iso

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §2.2.5 step 2: Take the ISO date from the current local date-time.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Reads and projects one instant with the supplied zone before extracting the date component of the ISO date-time.

key.symbol: impl<C: SystemClock> Now<C>::plain_time_iso

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §2.2.6 step 2: Take the time from the current local date-time.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Reads and projects one instant with the supplied zone before extracting its local clock component.

key.symbol: impl Default for ZonedWithOptions::default

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.31 steps 20–22: Supply typed zoned with defaults.
reviewed_rows.evidence: The typed option record defaults to Compatible, Prefer, and Constrain, which are the zoned with algorithm default values. JS option reads remain outside this type.

key.symbol: pub trait TimeZone::visit_offsets_at

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.13 step 3.a: Fall back to full offset enumeration for candidates.
reviewed_rows.evidence: The generic trait default delegates candidate offset enumeration to the full-history visitor. Consumers validate candidate instants. Specific providers may override the search.

key.symbol: impl TimeZone for FixedOffset::transition

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.46 step 8: Fixed offsets have no transition.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Always returns None for a fixed-offset provider regardless of instant or direction.

key.symbol: impl TimeZone for FixedOffset::offset_nanoseconds

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.9 step 2: Return the stored fixed offset in nanoseconds.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Returns the exact offset already stored in nanoseconds. Minute-aligned public offset parsing occurs elsewhere.

key.symbol: impl TimeZone for FixedOffset::visit_offsets

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.13 step 2.a: Supply the only offset for a fixed-zone candidate.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Offers the single configured offset as a dependency of typed local candidate reconstruction. Candidate construction and range validation are performed by the visitor.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone> ZonedDateTime<Z>::new

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.3 steps 4–6: Store a typed instant and zone with the ISO calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Creates the typed record from an already checked Instant and supplied zone, storing ISO as the calendar.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone> ZonedDateTime<Z>::from_local

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.11 steps 1–2: Resolve an ISO local date-time before storing it.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegates exact local fields and the selected disambiguation to resolve_local, then stores the resulting instant together with the zone and ISO calendar.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::new_in_calendar

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.3 steps 4–6: Store the typed instant, zone and calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Creates the native zoned record from validated typed dependencies. No public constructor behavior is inferred.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::calendar

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.31 step 6: Read the stored calendar provider.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Returns the typed provider stored on the native ZonedDateTime.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::calendar_id

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.3 step 3: Return the stored calendar provider ID.
reviewed_rows.evidence: The provider supplies its canonical ID for the typed getter.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::instant

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.47 step 3: Return the typed instant stored by the zoned value.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Returns the existing validated native Instant without offset or calendar transformations. JS object creation is handled separately.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::time_zone

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.46 step 3: Read the stored zone provider.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Returns the typed zone that owns transition and offset data. Public identifier spelling has a separate owner.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::with_time_zone

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.33 step 4: Replace the typed zone while preserving instant and calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Creates a new native zoned value with the supplied zone provider and retains the exact instant and calendar.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::local

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.10 steps 1–3: Project the exact instant into local date-time.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Adds the provider offset in exact nanoseconds and constructs the local date-time in the stored calendar. Provider and local-range premises remain scoped.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::from_local_in_calendar

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.11 steps 1–2 and §6.5.3 steps 4–6: Resolve a typed local date-time and store its calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Resolves ISO local fields through the supplied zone and disambiguation. Stores the resulting Instant and the selected calendar provider.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::with_fields

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.31 steps 18, 23 and 25–26: Merge typed fields and resolve with an exact offset hint.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Validates presence of a partial field or offset, delegates typed local update, defaults the offset hint to the source zone offset, and delegates exact offset interpretation. JS field/property reads remain separate.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::with_calendar

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.34 step 4: Replace the typed calendar while preserving instant and zone.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Changes the calendar provider and retains the exact instant and zone.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::with_time

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.32 steps 6.a, 7.b–7.c and 8: Replace the local clock or use start of day.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Uses day boundary lookup for an absent time. Combines the given time with the current local date for compatible resolution and preserves the zone and calendar.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::start_of_day

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.45 steps 5–7: Resolve the start of the current local day.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Projects to the local ISO epoch day, delegates start-of-day lookup and reconstructs with the existing zone and calendar.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::hours_in_day

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.23 steps 5–10: Take the span between consecutive local day boundaries in hours.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Subtracts exact boundary nanoseconds before conversion to hours. Local day window assumptions remain with the provider.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::round

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.39 steps 19.c, 19.e, 19.i and 20.a–20.c: Supply typed zoned rounding branches.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Day branch resolves actual boundaries before rounding within the day. Clock branch rounds local time and prefers a matching exact source offset before compatible fallback. Scope excludes JS option reads and conditional endpoint/zero-span proposal premises.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::day_boundary

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.45 step 6: Delegate day boundary lookup for the stored zone.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Supplies the ISO epoch day and stored provider to the common day boundary resolver.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::transition

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.3.46 steps 9.a, 10.b and 11–12: Query a typed transition and preserve zone and calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Delegates direction and exact instant to the typed provider. Absent result stays None. Present result creates a typed zoned value with the unchanged zone/calendar.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::checked_add

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.5 steps 1, 3, 6 and 7: Add date units locally and clock units on the instant.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Adds the calendar part to local fields when present and resolves compatible. Adds the exact clock part to the resulting instant, or to the source instant for a clock-only duration.

key.symbol: impl<Z: TimeZone + Clone, C: CalendarProvider> ZonedDateTime<Z, C>::checked_subtract

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §6.5.10 steps 2 and 8: Negate the typed duration and delegate zoned addition.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Negates all validated duration fields before delegating to checked_add with unchanged overflow.

key.symbol: module::visit_possible_instants

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.13 step 3.a: Convert typed ISO fields before visiting candidate instants.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Converts typed ISO fields to exact local nanoseconds and forwards them into the provider candidate visitor. Scope follows valid Instant candidate contract.

key.symbol: module::visit_possible_nanoseconds

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.13 step 3.a: Keep in-range candidates whose provider offset round-trips.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Subtracts each strictly sub-day candidate offset from exact local nanoseconds, accepts valid instants only when their offset matches the offset used. Any mixed-validity endpoint premise is separate.

key.symbol: module::day_boundary

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.14 steps 1–3, 5 and 7: Resolve midnight or find the containing forward transition.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Uses compatible resolution for midnight, checks whether it round-trips, then searches the preceding transition interval for the gap containing midnight. Scope limited to the existing provider premises.

key.symbol: module::resolve_local

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.11 steps 1–2: Convert local fields and delegate candidate disambiguation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Converts exact typed ISO fields to epoch-like local nanoseconds and delegates with the same zone/disambiguation.

key.symbol: module::resolve_local_nanoseconds

reviewed_rows.annotation: // Proposal comparison §11.1.12 steps 2, 3.a–3.d and 5: Select the requested candidate or apply reject.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Selects the minimum and maximum validated candidates, handles one candidate and distinguishes earlier/later/reject. The separate containing-gap transition fallback requires the local provider premise.

validation.result: 12 Bazel targets passed in the same validation batch.
